about: What this repository's own workflows need from GitHub, and the hardening its threat model says is in force. The skills' catalogues describe the copies of their workflows that it runs. `ktl gh` reads this file; skills/ktl-sidecar/references/repository-settings.md describes its fields.

settings.name: release
settings.why: Every workflow write to main, and each publication of the skills, runs here on the default branch alone. A required reviewer waits until releases have downstream users.

settings.name: pypi
settings.why: PyPI's trusted publisher names this Environment and not a ref, so it admits release tags alone.

settings.name: testpypi
settings.why: TestPyPI's trusted publisher names this Environment and not a ref, so it admits release tags alone.

settings.name: docent-eval
settings.why: It holds the eval agent's key for the default branch's weekly run alone.

settings.name: PYPI_RELEASE_ENABLED

requires.confirm: the index has a trusted publisher, pending or registered, for both ktl and knowledge-trust-ladder, naming this repository, pypi.yml and the Environment

settings.why: testpypi uploads each release to TestPyPI, and true to PyPI. Unset, a release builds and checks the packages and uploads nothing.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_SYNC_HOSTS
settings.why: The hosts asked to sync as soon as a release is tagged, as owner/name separated by spaces.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_SYNC_DISPATCH_TOKEN
settings.why: A token with Actions write on each sync host. A fine-grained token reaches one owner's repositories alone.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_DOCENT_EVAL_ENABLED

requires.text: AGENT_API_KEY_ENV, the name the agent reads its key from
the AGENT_API_KEY secret in Environment docent-eval

settings.why: true runs the docent eval each week: eight paid agent runs under the cost cap.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_DOCENT_EVAL_COST
settings.why: The eval's cost cap in US dollars, 5 unless set.

settings.name: AGENT_API_KEY_ENV
settings.why: The name the eval's agent reads its key from. The librarian reads the same variable.

settings.name: AGENT_API_KEY
settings.why: The eval agent's key, for the eval's job alone.

settings.name: default branch
settings.why: main blocks deletion and force pushes and requires linear history, and no more: a pull request or status rule would refuse the release job's own push.

settings.name: actions.default_workflow_permissions
settings.why: A workflow that names no permissions gets a read-only token.

settings.name: security.secret_scanning
settings.why: Secret scanning is on, as the threat model says, and nothing in CI can assert it.

settings.name: security.secret_scanning_push_protection
settings.why: Push protection is on, as the threat model says, and nothing in CI can assert it.

settings.name: security.private_vulnerability_reporting
settings.why: SECURITY.md sends reporters to private vulnerability reporting.

settings.name: security.vulnerability_alerts
settings.why: Dependabot's security updates need its alerts.

settings.name: security.dependabot_security_updates
settings.why: The .lokf entry in .github/dependabot.yml turns version updates off and relies on security updates.

settings.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
settings.why: scorecard.yml publishes the score the README's badge shows, as the threat model says.

settings.name: CodeQL
settings.why: codeql.yml scans the Python, the JavaScript and the workflows, as the threat model says.
